profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure at Airbnb
profile.summary:
Engineer focused on helping companies develop novel, efficient, stable, and highly scalable software infrastructure, using a broad set of heterogeneous components to solve diverse business problems. I've worked on areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Semantic Technologies, Graph Databases and Distributed Systems. Lately, I've been working on designing and building Big Data infrastructure processing Petabyte scale datasets.
Specialties: programming, algorithmic design, data integration, distributed systems, web services, semantic technologies, systems integration, software architecture design, object oriented design, big data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Graph Analytics: Design and implementation of Apache TinkerPop 3 Framework for the Stardog Graph Database, becoming the first graph database supporting property graphs with automated reasoning
- Distributed Systems: Improved implementation of Stardog’s algorithms for cluster membership and leader election, enhancing cluster's reliability
- Applications: Created a full development stack for semantic applications based on Stardog
- Applications: Design and implementation of the Stardog’s Web Console and Stardog Linked Data API
- Open Source: Developed open source client library for Stardog in JavaScript: https://github.com/stardog-union/stardog.js
- Worked on improving several Stardog components

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Fully responsible of design and coding for the main data loader tool implemented in C# using the MS Oﬃce object model interfacing with the company's platform and several Web Services.
- Design and code Java Web Services for remote ﬁle management through the company's platform.
- Design part of a highly scalable web application and its data model to integrate worldwide data.
- Management and design of a project for the implementation of data mining techniques in order to provide predictions for user behavior in the company’s platform, using MongoDB as store for user actions.
- Followed agile software development methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Code product features, database development and middleware software for integration with the Salesforce platform.
- Design and implementation of a custom authentication protocol for the login system
of the company’s products.
- Development of data integration processes, as well as custom data loaders for the
company’s platform.

projects.title: Stardog
projects.description: Stardog is a fast, commercial RDF database: SPARQL for queries; OWL for reasoning; pure Java for the Enterprise.

projects.title: OntoReview: Application of Ontology Models on Reviews Systems - Master's Thesis
projects.description: In this thesis a new model for reviews structure is proposed, which pretends to shift the paradigm about traditional online reviews, how they are represented in the Web and saved into data stores. A structured semantic model for reviews is presented, which could help leverage reviews data processing as well as semantic annotation of objects. The contribution of this thesis actually hits right in the crosspoint of two current problems in the web, unstructured noisy reviews data mining and semantic lack of content in the web.

publications.title: Evaluation of query rewriting approaches for OWL 2
publications.publisher: Proc. of the Joint Workshop on Scalable and High-Performance Semantic Web Systems (SSWS+ HPCSW 2012) · Nov 1, 2012
